Package theknife.gui

Class RoundedComponentUI

java.lang.Object
javax.swing.plaf.ComponentUI
javax.swing.plaf.LayerUI<JComponent>
theknife.gui.RoundedComponentUI
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable
public final class RoundedComponentUI extends LayerUI<JComponent>
A custom LayerUI implementation that applies a rounded clipping mask to the wrapped JComponent, allowing for smooth rounded corners.

This UI delegate can be used with a JLayer to visually enhance components without modifying their internal rendering logic.

Author:
Damiano De Mutiis 761348 (CO), Matteo Porto Bonacci 761396 (CO), Matteo Monticone 761701 (CO), Mattia Tamburo 761743 (CO)

      public final void paint(Graphics g, JComponent c)
      Overrides the paint method from LayerUI<JComponent>.

      Applies a rounded clipping shape to the wrapped component before painting, allowing for custom rendering effects.

      For more information on customizing the layer behavior, see LayerUI<JComponent>.
